description: Opens the attachment fixture read-only and asks: metadata and Field2 properties of T.Att, the TypeInfo of the Att Field2 and of the child recordset and its FileData field, the catalog rows, the group of every parent read to EOF (FileData, FileName, FileType and the other child fields with typed values), then FieldSize, GetChunk(0,16) and SaveToFile of the FileData of p1, the two of p2 and p4 into work files (kept, with file images).
retentionNote: Designed r-cplx-rebuild probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
